verses.gurmukhi: ਧਰਮਸਾਲ ਕਰਿ ਬਹੀਦਾ ਇਕਤ ਥਾਉਂ ਨ ਟਿਕੈ ਟਿਕਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: dharamasaal kar baheedhaa ikat thaau(n) na Tikai Tikaiaa|

en.bdb: The earlier Gurus considered that to give instructions and to preach to the people, one has to sit at one place known as dharamshala, but this Guru (Hargobind) does riot stick to one place.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ਘਰਿ ਆਵਦੇ ਗੜਿ ਚੜਿਆ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ਚੜਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: paatisaeh ghar aavadhe gaR chaRiaa paatisaeh chaRaiaa|

en.bdb: Earlier emperors would visit the house of the Guru, but this Guru has been interned by the king in a fort.

verses.gurmukhi: ਉਮਤਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਦੀ ਨਠਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਨ ਡਰੈ ਡਰਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: aumat mahal na paavadhee naThaa firai na ddarai ddaraiaa|

en.bdb: The sarigat coming to have his glimpse cannot find him in the palace (because generally he is not available). Neither he is scared of anybody nor does he scare any one yet he is always on the move.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੰਜੀ ਬਹਿ ਸੰਤੋਖਦਾ ਕੁਤੇ ਰਖਿ ਸਿਕਾਰੁ ਖਿਲਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: ma(n)jee beh sa(n)tokhadhaa kute rakh sikaar khilaiaa|

en.bdb: Earlier Gurus sitting on the seat instructed people to be content but this Guru rears dogs and goes out for hunting.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਣੀ ਕਰਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਗਾਂਵਦਾ ਕਥੈ ਨ ਸੁਣੈ ਨ ਗਾਵਿ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: baanee kar sun gaa(n)vadhaa kathai na sunai na gaav sunaiaa|

en.bdb: The Gurus used to listen to Gurbani but this Guru neither recites nor (regularly) listens to hymn-singing.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕ ਪਾਸ ਨ ਰਖੀਅਨਿ ਦੋਖੀ ਦੁਸਟ ਆਗੂ ਮੁਹਿ ਲਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: sevak paas na rakheean dhokhee dhusaT aagoo muh laiaa|

en.bdb: He does not keep his follower servants with him and rather maintains nearness with the wicked and the envious ones (Guru had kept Painde Khan nearby).

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਨ ਲੁਕੈ ਲੁਕਾਇਆ ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਸਿਖ ਭਵਰ ਲੁਭਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: sach na lukai lukaiaa charan kaval sikh bhavar lubhaiaa|

en.bdb: But the truth is never concealed and that is why on the lotus feet of the Guru, the mind of 'Sikhs hover like a greedy black-bee.
Guru Hargobding has borne the unbearable and he has not made himself manifest.
